title: 3. Playfully Irreverent
slide_intent: Give humor a visible expression so a playful personality can be recognized before the copy is read.
strategic_value: The face-like Chicken Fries pack can make Burger King’s warmth and irreverence tangible.
demonstration: Cream principle copy sits at left on orange while a tilted open Chicken Fries carton fills the right.
practical_value: Look for ways product packaging can carry personality while remaining identifiable.

content_islands.name: Principle copy
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and personality paragraph in the left half.

content_islands.name: Characterful packaging
content_islands.spec: Place the tilted orange carton with eyes and a beak at right, open to reveal the food.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source defines warmth, wit and disruption as parts of its personality.
reference_purposes.Application: Chicken Fries packaging demonstrates the principle through a face-like carton.
